The Instability of Naked Singularities in the Gravitational Collapse of a Scalar Field

ledger.evidence_excerpt: Abstract: 'One of the fundamental unanswered questions in the general theory of relativity is whether ``naked'' singularities, that is singular events which are visible from infinity, may form with positive probability in the process of gravitational collapse. The present paper, which is a continuation previous work, addresses this question in the context of the spherical gravitational collapse of a scalar field.' Journal ref: Ann. of Math.
